Development version, built on @DATE@ at @TIME@ UTC from commit [@COMMIT@](@COMMIT_URL@). It is built at night whenever Evochora has changed, and may contain errors.

The next nightly replaces this one. A simulation run is reproduced and continued exactly only by the build that recorded it, so for a run you want to come back to, use a release with a version number: it stays available.

Choose the archive for your platform, unpack it, and start Evochora as the [Quick Start](https://github.com/evochora/evochora#quick-start) describes.
